summary: The claim and proof are mathematically sound. Small and degenerate supports, arbitrary orientations, disconnected graphs, and extreme fields introduce no counterexample. The exact row census and independent-set bijection are valid. Definition 1.1 and Theorem 1.8 of the cited arXiv v3 were checked directly: their signed influence convention, maximum-degree bound, activity, gap parameter, and smallest applicable size match the covariance argument. Every predecessor is used with its original canonical quantities and normalization. The mask partition preserves exact fibers, its capacity estimate and halfspace transfer justify the uniform second-moment coefficient, and Jensen gives the stated third moment. The elementary degree-two coefficient also follows from the supplied accepted facts.
